items.title: Remote Teleop for arms
items.summary: Today we are announcing the addition of two new control modalities to our Remote Teleop capability: VR controllers and mouse gestures. With these you can now control arms, mobile bases, or both at the same time, from anywhere in the world. This is useful both for continuous data collection as well as on-demand intervention on deployed robots.
